label: 'So you're a drama leeching loser…' (11 nov, 04:55)
html:
Anonymous asked:

https://www.tumblr.com/slashmoth/832950119946223617/are-unanswered-asks-asks-from-chocos-supporters?source=share

https://www.tumblr.com/slashmoth/832949860480221184/yall-idk-if-you-guys-thought-i-did-but-i-dont?source=share

So you're a drama leeching loser being used as a fiddlestick for Grave supporters and still think Choco supporters give enough of a fuck to send you anything, get over a grip on reality please, you are NOT important like this.

It's ultimately for the best since the more bots like you we see the more of Froggo's Grave's and Choco's groomers' supporters we can block so your names don't show up and so people can keep you blocked.

I also REALLY doubt Choco gives s fuck enough to hate on you at all, you said it yourself, you're pretty much irrelevant, Choco isn't even talking to you, anons are communicating on both sides and you're the willing guinea pig which imho is loser behavior, like I think anyone with a life doesn't care about this shit enough to get Choco's attention.

Why would I hate a mosquito? It's their supporters who are known for sending asks to random people to gain support. I've seen people talk about Gravekandy in a negative light, and his supporters argue with anons as if it could be disputed, as if there were "two sides" or "there's nuance".

There is no nuance: you either support a grooming ring or you don't, and the only way to be truly neutral is to stay out.

Also, admitting to being a peddling bot for Gravekandy supporters is not the flex they think it is. No wonder people have blocked them; this is why nobody likes any of you.

They clearly care enough to be a nuisance trying to peddle grooming ring anons, so that's a lie, the nth one from the user so far.

Perish the thought of me spending any time on their account responding to them. I use a script that re-posts all my call-outs; if they think I spend any genuine effort picking their excuses apart and refuting their deflections, they're even more parasocial than I originally thought. Like anon has stated, long responses? These aren't for slashmoth; slashmoth is being thrown around to find a use in life, since they clearly can't go beyond being a clout-chasing Choco situation member as a life goal.

You can all certainly keep this up, though. It's funny calling you out, because at the end of the day, being a Gravekandy supporter will always be scorned and socially repudiated. Everyone blocks LARPers for a reason.

I'm going to stay right where I'm at and drink my hot chocolate.
